specs.title: Slug and public tenant page
specs.why: This is the merchant's shareable shopfront and the entry point for every public booking.
specs.scope: `/{slug}` SSR route renders a branded landing page: business name, logo, services list, hours and a Book now CTA. Correct SEO meta and Open Graph tags. Cache with stale-while-revalidate.
tasks: 404 for a missing or inactive tenant
acceptance: A valid slug renders with TTFB under 500ms
Lighthouse SEO score is 95 or above

specs.title: Availability engine
specs.why: Slot computation is the highest-risk logic in the product and benefits from being pure and exhaustively tested.
specs.scope: Pure function `computeSlots(service, dateRange, existingBookings, hours, buffers, leadTime, maxAdvance)` returning open slots. No side effects, fully unit-tested.
tasks: Handle service duration, buffer, lead time and max-advance
Exhaustive unit tests including edge cases
acceptance: Correct slots are returned for all test fixtures
Runs in under 50ms on the benchmark dataset
